en.title: SBB Tech's KRW 1.9 Billion Reducer Supply Contract: Term and Scale Versus Revenue
en.summary: This is a staged image to aid understanding of the article. SBB Tech disclosed a supply contract for precision reducers used in humanoid robots on August 24, 2026. The confirmed contract value is KRW 1,923,419,100, which is 26.7% of the KRW 7,197,979,874 in 2025 revenue the company reported in the disclosure.…
